liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Viola Lee Blues** (4 reviews): About twenty minutes long, with Garcia exploring every opportunity the song offers; Runs 20:20 and is named the standout of the recording [7][8][9][10]
- **New Potato Caboose** (1 review, 1 other source): Garcia introduces the song with a spoken line before it starts; Garcia introduces it by name just before the song begins [1][8]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: Feedback [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1967-08-04.09110.sbd.vernon.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 3 songs; 26 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [1]
- **gd67-08-04.sbd.hanno.16752.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 2 songs; 27 min; rated 4.62/5 by 16 [2]. Said about its sound: Vocals are better than usual for the time, though rough in places; Reviewer puts the sound quality at about seventy percent; Sound is noticeably less flat than the commonly circulating version [2][7][11]
- **gd1967-08-04.10355.sbd.hurwitt.shnf**: soundboard; 2 songs; 26 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer guesses the Dead opened for Jefferson Airplane, who also played on this date [5]
- A taping compendium lists Alligator as the first track, but it is missing from this tape [6]
- Part of Bill Graham's 'The San Francisco Scene in Toronto', also featuring Jefferson Airplane and Luke And The Apostles [1]
- The poster shows shows from July 31 to August 5, with Wednesday and Saturday matinees [1]
- The compendium says the Alligator jam is as intense as the Caution from 2/14/70 [6]
- Reviewer rates the 5/5/67 stage banter as a better example of Garcia's early comments [8]
- Garcia is less repetitive here than in other versions, and the band is unusually tight [11]
- Garcia's playing reminds the reviewer of Jerry Miller of Moby Grape [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1967-08-04.09110.sbd.vernon.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: SBD>MR>R>DAT>CDR [1]
- **gd67-08-04.sbd.hanno.16752.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Hanno Bunjes & Uli Teute; source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1967-08-04.10355.sbd.hurwitt.shnf**: source: Stereo SBD MR>R>DAT(3)>CDR(unknown number of CD gens)>EAC> Cool Edit 2000>CD Wave>SHN [3]. Also: SHNs made by Greg Hurwitt from seed discs supplied by Stu Hanson of the BUDD list; Discs ripped twice with EAC and checksums compared; clicks were removed using Cool Edit 2000 [3]
